steps.en: Copy skill/seecut into your agent's skills folder and run its preflight until every required check is green
steps.zh: 把 skill/seecut 放进 skills 目录，跑预检直到必需项全绿

steps.en: Drop a 20–30 s vertical talking-head clip (plus optional screenshots) in one folder and invoke the skill
steps.zh: 把 20–30 秒竖屏口播（可加截图）放进一个文件夹，调用 skill

steps.en: Watches the footage with a video-native model (Gemini via agy) and builds a word-level timeline
steps.zh: 用能看视频的模型（agy 调 Gemini）看片，并做词级时间轴

steps.en: Screenshots real pages the script mentions as on-screen evidence; fake UIs are forbidden
steps.zh: 按台词截真网页当画面证据，禁止用假界面凑画面

steps.en: Plans every shot from its design tokens and decision table, then renders the composition with HyperFrames
steps.zh: 按设计令牌与决策表逐镜编排，用 HyperFrames 渲染成片

steps.en: Sign off on the short sample before it spends an hour on the full video (asked first for footage over 60 s)
steps.zh: 超过 60 秒的素材会先出样片，等你确认风格再跑全片

steps.en: Gates each version: a geometry self-check plus an AI critique that watches the rendered video
steps.zh: 每版过硬门：几何自检，再让 AI 看成片挑硬伤

steps.en: Adopts a new version only after two order-swapped head-to-head wins against the previous one (max 3)
steps.zh: 和上一版两两对比、交换顺序各跑一次都赢才采纳（最多 3 版）

steps.en: Delivers the MP4, a layered project package, and a JianYing draft if the optional engine is installed
steps.zh: 交付成片加分层工程包；装了剪映引擎再推剪映分层草稿

value.en: No manual keyframes for the motion pass — every version beat a judge that actually watched it, and you keep the final say in JianYing
value.zh: 动效不用手 K 帧：每版都是赢过一个真看过片的评委才留下，最终你在剪映逐层定夺
